name: Elder Grove · Heart Tree
_design: Elder Grove zone (level-designer 2026-11-24; zone elder_tree, order 4). Generated by tools/maps/build_elder_grove.gd (edit the script, not this file): the goblin courtyard board (same bounds, spawns, no cover) on a floating island deep in an ancient giant-tree forest: mossy loam board, cushion-moss margins, walls of rotting stumps and gnarled roots north/east/west, an open cliff in front with ferns and mushrooms only, soft green-gold sunlight baked as dapples through the leaves. The giant elder tree stands in the middle of the north wall, its roots spilling over the back margin and running flat across the board into a ring of roots round a moss heart in the middle of the fight (the memorable feature, nothing to trip on). Sunlight falls through its canopy in gold dapples. A small mossy shrine with two stone lanterns sits on the east margin, smaller trees in the back corners, ferns and glow-capped mushrooms on the open front cliff. Monster ids here are a PLACEHOLDER fixture (family-neutral old monsters: the elder family does not exist yet); the zone's journey will bring the real waves onto the spots in list order.
_arena: Board 16 x 9 m, the goblin courtyard's (same spawns, no cover: logic/auto_pilot.gd walks straight at its target). Nothing stands on the board (roots and stones on it are flat inlays under 0.1 m); trees, walls and the shrine are on the island margins, the front (camera side) is an open cliff.
_spots: Spot roles in order: melee, melee, melee, melee, knight, melee, archer, mage
